notes: Smoke-test corpora for frontier-ai. Every entry must name a source URL, an SPDX licence id from the allow-list in src/frontier_ai/data/corpora.py, and an attribution string. sha256 stays null until scripts/fetch_smoke_corpus.py has actually retrieved the file and its licence marker has been found; nothing here is asserted from memory. Keep the corpus SMALL: it is a fixture, not training data.
